recording.lineage: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4s w/6" diameter plexiglass plates directly behind the rear pickups of the capsules> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Official Taping Section 8 Ft. Stand (Sec. 128, Row C, seat 4) . | The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.note: Supplied catalogue listing: Archive.org; Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1991-03-17. Source references: archive-index archive-url-snapshot. Metadata attribution is unreviewed.
